hero.title: SalonGo Kasa
hero.lead: Checkout software for nail salons that you buy once and keep. It runs on the salon's own computer and keeps selling even offline.
hero.fact1: Your data stays on the salon's computer

checkout.d: Pick the service and the technician, take payment and the receipt prints right away.

eet.d: Sends sales under the new 2027 law, nothing for you to worry about.

thuchi.d: See what came in, what went out and what you kept today.

services.d: Your price list, change it whenever you like.

staff.d: See what each technician earned, so payroll is easy.

customers.d: Name, phone and their last visit.

faq.title: Common questions
faq.q1: How is Kasa different from SalonGo?
faq.a1: Kasa is for salons that only need checkout and bookkeeping on one computer, pay once and you're done. If you want appointments, online booking or to work from your phone, SalonGo is the better fit.
faq.a2: Yes. Kasa takes payments and prints receipts offline, and EET sends itself once you're back online.
faq.a3: Right on your salon's computer. Kasa backs up every day to a USB stick or a Google Drive folder.
faq.a4: No problem. Call or message SalonGo, we move your code to the new computer and your data stays.
faq.a5: No. You pay {price} once per computer and that's it.

what.title: A till that lives|on the salon's computer.
what.lead: Kasa is checkout software you install on the Windows PC or Mac at your front desk. It does the job of a POS terminal: takes payments, prints receipts, sends EET and keeps your income and expenses.
what.c1d: Pay {price} once per computer. No monthly fee and nothing to renew.
what.c2d: Your data stays on the salon's computer with a daily backup. If the internet drops, you keep selling and printing.
what.c3d: Kasa has no appointment calendar, no online booking and no phone app. That is what SalonGo does.

pick.title: Two different products.|Pick by how your salon works.
pick.k1: You only need checkout, receipts and EET on one computer
pick.k2: Clients walk in, nobody books ahead
pick.k3: You don't want a monthly fee
pick.g1: You need a calendar per staff member and online booking
pick.g2: You want to see the salon on your phone or iPad, anywhere
pick.g3: You have a team to pay or several locations

buySteps.title: Buy Kasa|in 3 steps.
buySteps.s1dOnline: Click Buy Kasa, enter your e-mail (and IČO if you have one), then pay by card or bank transfer.
buySteps.s1dContact: Call SalonGo or message us on WhatsApp or Facebook. We answer in Czech or Vietnamese.
buySteps.s2d: Download Kasa for free and install it on the computer at your front desk. The step-by-step guide is right below.
buySteps.s3t: Contact SalonGo for your activation code
buySteps.s3d: Once it's installed, call or message SalonGo. We send you an activation code; enter it in Kasa and you're ready. One code = one computer.

guide.title: Install Kasa step by step,|no tech skills needed.
guide.lead: Follow these 5 steps and you can take payments in about 10 minutes. Stuck anywhere? Call SalonGo and we'll do it with you on the phone.
guide.note: Illustrations. The real screens may look slightly different.
guide.s1d: On the Download Kasa page, pick Windows, Mac (Apple M1–M4) or Mac (Intel). Not sure which Mac? Apple menu → About This Mac.
guide.s2d: Windows: open the .exe file, click Install and wait. Mac: open the .dmg file and drag the Kasa icon into Applications.
guide.s3t: Contact SalonGo and enter your activation code
guide.s3d: Once it's installed, call or message SalonGo for your activation code. Open Kasa, type or paste the KASA-… code and click Activate. The computer needs internet for this step.
guide.s4d: Choose a PIN to open Kasa every day. Salon name, IČO and address can wait.
guide.s5t: Add services and ring up the first sale
guide.s5d: Enter your price list and staff names. Pick services, press Pay and the receipt prints. If you need EET 2.0, add your EET certificate once.
guide.help: Want someone to install it for you?
guide.helpD: Call or message SalonGo and we'll guide you on the phone in Czech or Vietnamese.
